import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { canonicalizeJson } from '@cvg/harness-contracts';
import { SESSION_EVENT_CATALOG_V1 as catalog } from '@cvg/harness-contracts';
export class SessionEventError extends Error {
    code;
    constructor(code, message) {
        super(message);
        this.code = code;
        this.name = 'SessionEventError';
    }
}
function invalid() {
    throw new SessionEventError('invalid_session_event', 'Invalid session event, schema, version or fingerprint');
}
export const SESSION_EVENT_MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
/** Strict JSON, not JS values silently dropped/coerced by JSON.stringify. */
function json(value) {
    let nodes = 0;
    const seen = new Set();
    const visit = (v, depth) => {
        if (++nodes > 20_000 || depth > 64)
            invalid();
        if (v === null || typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'boolean')
            return;
        if (typeof v === 'number') {
            if (!Number.isFinite(v))
                invalid();
            return;
        }
        if (typeof v !== 'object' || v === null || seen.has(v))
            invalid();
        seen.add(v);
        if (Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(v).length)
            invalid();
        if (Array.isArray(v)) {
            const descriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(v);
            if (Object.keys(descriptors).some((key) => key !== 'length' && !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(key)))
                invalid();
            for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
                const descriptor = descriptors[String(i)];
                if (!descriptor || !('value' in descriptor) || !descriptor.enumerable)
                    invalid();
                visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1);
            }
        }
        else {
            if (Object.getPrototypeOf(v) !== Object.prototype &&
                Object.getPrototypeOf(v) !== null)
                invalid();
            for (const descriptor of Object.values(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(v))) {
                if (!('value' in descriptor) || !descriptor.enumerable)
                    invalid();
                visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1);
            }
        }
        seen.delete(v);
    };
    visit(value, 0);
}
function check(schema, value) {
    if (schema.$ref) {
        const key = schema.$ref.replace(/^#\/definitions\//, '');
        const target = catalog.definitions[key];
        // Unreachable: every catalog $ref points to a declared definition.
        /* v8 ignore next */
        if (!target)
            invalid();
        check(target, value);
        return;
    }
    if (schema.enum && !schema.enum.includes(value))
        invalid();
    switch (schema.type) {
        case 'string': {
            if (typeof value !== 'string')
                invalid();
            if (schema.minLength !== undefined &&
                (!value.trim() || value.length < schema.minLength))
                invalid();
            if (schema.maxLength !== undefined && value.length > schema.maxLength)
                invalid();
            if (schema.pattern && !new RegExp(schema.pattern).test(value))
                invalid();
            if (schema['x-maxUtf8Bytes'] !== undefined &&
                Buffer.byteLength(value, 'utf8') > schema['x-maxUtf8Bytes'])
                invalid();
            break;
        }
        case 'integer':
        case 'number':
            if (typeof value !== 'number' ||
                !Number.isFinite(value) ||
                (schema.type === 'integer' && !Number.isSafeInteger(value)))
                invalid();
            if (schema.minimum !== undefined && value < schema.minimum)
                invalid();
            // Unreachable: every catalog maximum is the safe-integer ceiling.
            /* v8 ignore next */
            if (schema.maximum !== undefined && value > schema.maximum)
                invalid();
            break;
        case 'array':
            if (!Array.isArray(value))
                invalid();
            // Unreachable: every catalog array schema declares `items`.
            /* v8 ignore next */
            if (schema.items)
                for (const item of value)
                    check(schema.items, item);
            break;
        case 'object': {
            if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
                invalid();
            const record = value;
            for (const key of schema.required ?? [])
                if (!Object.hasOwn(record, key))
                    invalid();
            for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(record)) {
                const child = schema.properties && Object.hasOwn(schema.properties, key)
                    ? schema.properties[key]
                    : undefined;
                if (child)
                    check(child, item);
                else if (schema.additionalProperties === false)
                    invalid();
            }
            break;
        }
    }
}
function exact(record, required, optional = []) {
    if (required.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(record, key)) ||
        Object.keys(record).some((key) => !required.includes(key) && !optional.includes(key)))
        invalid();
}
function record(value) {
    json(value);
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
        invalid();
    return value;
}
const fields = [
    'tenantId',
    'sessionId',
    'formatVersion',
    'eventId',
    'timestamp',
    'correlationId',
    'traceId',
    'type',
    'payload'
];
export function sessionEventFingerprint(type) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(catalog.events, type))
        invalid();
    return createHash('sha256')
        .update(canonicalizeJson({
        formatVersion: 1,
        type,
        payload: catalog.events[type],
        definitions: catalog.definitions
    }))
        .digest('hex');
}
export function validateSessionStream(value) {
    const r = record(value);
    exact(r, ['tenantId', 'sessionId', 'formatVersion']);
    check(catalog.definitions.id, r.tenantId);
    check(catalog.definitions.id, r.sessionId);
    if (r.formatVersion !== 1)
        invalid();
    return {
        tenantId: r.tenantId,
        sessionId: r.sessionId,
        formatVersion: 1
    };
}
function validateAppendRecord(r) {
    validateSessionStream({
        tenantId: r.tenantId,
        sessionId: r.sessionId,
        formatVersion: r.formatVersion
    });
    for (const key of ['eventId', 'correlationId', 'traceId'])
        check(catalog.definitions.id, r[key]);
    if (typeof r.timestamp !== 'string' ||
        !/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d\.\d{3}Z$/.test(r.timestamp) ||
        !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.timestamp)) ||
        new Date(r.timestamp).toISOString() !== r.timestamp)
        invalid();
    if (typeof r.type !== 'string' || !Object.hasOwn(catalog.events, r.type))
        invalid();
    check(catalog.events[r.type], r.payload);
    const payload = r.payload;
    if ('correlationId' in payload && payload.correlationId !== r.correlationId)
        invalid();
    if (r.type === 'model/request' &&
        payload.request.correlationId !==
            r.correlationId)
        invalid();
}
export function validateSessionEventAppend(value) {
    const r = record(value);
    exact(r, fields);
    validateAppendRecord(r);
    // Reserve enough room for store-owned fields; materialization checks exact cap.
    if (Buffer.byteLength(canonicalizeJson(r)) > SESSION_EVENT_MAX_BYTES)
        invalid();
    return JSON.parse(canonicalizeJson(r));
}
export function validateSessionEvent(value) {
    const r = record(value);
    exact(r, [...fields, 'sequence', 'schemaFingerprint']);
    validateAppendRecord(r);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(r.sequence) ||
        r.sequence < 1 ||
        r.schemaFingerprint !== sessionEventFingerprint(r.type))
        invalid();
    if (r.type === 'context/compacted' &&
        r.payload.throughSequence >=
            r.sequence)
        invalid();
    if (Buffer.byteLength(canonicalizeJson(r)) > SESSION_EVENT_MAX_BYTES)
        invalid();
    return JSON.parse(canonicalizeJson(r));
}
export function materializeSessionEvent(input, sequence) {
    return validateSessionEvent({
        ...input,
        sequence,
        schemaFingerprint: sessionEventFingerprint(input.type)
    });
}
export function sessionEventInputDigest(value) {
    return createHash('sha256')
        .update(canonicalizeJson(validateSessionEventAppend(value)))
        .digest('hex');
}
export function validateSessionEventRead(value) {
    const r = record(value);
    exact(r, ['tenantId', 'sessionId'], ['afterSequence', 'limit']);
    check(catalog.definitions.id, r.tenantId);
    check(catalog.definitions.id, r.sessionId);
    const afterSequence = r.afterSequence ?? 0;
    const limit = r.limit ?? 100;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(afterSequence) ||
        afterSequence < 0 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(limit) ||
        limit < 1 ||
        limit > 500)
        invalid();
    return {
        tenantId: r.tenantId,
        sessionId: r.sessionId,
        afterSequence: afterSequence,
        limit: limit
    };
}
